parakeet: So the verdict? Atheism is not proof of no God. It's the rational response to insufficient evidence. Because no theistic claim, Christian, Islamic, Hindu, or otherwise, has ever met the public, repeatable, testable, explanatory criteria, atheism holds that it's unwarranted to believe in gods. When you combine the repeated failure of supernatural claims under rigorous scrutiny, the superior explanatory and practical power of naturalistic frameworks, and the internal contradictions or incoherence in many deity concepts, the logical position is, I withhold belief until and unless credible objective evidence arises. In short, the evidence for atheism is precisely that no God claim satisfies the stringent criteria of public, repeatable, testable, and explanatory data, while naturalistic explanations continue to fill those roles.
